description:
Get the next pair of entities to evaluate.

Strategies: adaptive (default), swiss, balanced, random,
uncertainty, explore, information_gain, escalation -- the same
selection the web app uses. Left/right order is randomised, and the
pair comes with no rating or predicted winner (match_quality is
closeness only), so show it to the voter as-is.

`escalation` is the human review queue: only pairs an AI judge could
not be trusted on (it tied, contradicted itself when A and B were
swapped, disagreed with another judge, or was unsure), until enough
people have voted on each. `adaptive` already mixes them in.
`escalated: true` marks such a pair and never says which side the
judge leaned to. A vote submitted with an API key resolves an
escalation only when the ranking's owner turned on
`escalation_count_api_votes` (aimrank_set_quality_config).

api_key is optional on the public endpoint; on /mcp/mcp a missing
key is refused.
name: aimrank_get_matchup
